metadata.description: Initial baseline seed for nightly benchmark regression detection. Values are PLACEHOLDER nominal estimates derived from hnsw_pure.rs / hybrid_queries.rs / stress_test.rs / high_density.rs inspection — they MUST be refreshed by the first scheduled nightly run. After the first nightly (cron '0 3 * * *') completes without regression, scripts/bench_regression.py update-baseline benchmark_report_criterion.json will overwrite this file with measured mean_ms / median_ms / std_ms from target/criterion/. Labels cover the 5 nightly benchmark groups; bench_concurrent/ is intentionally absent (that bench uses a custom main() and does not produce estimates.json — see TBH-10). Refresh procedure: git pull, wait for next nightly, or run cargo bench locally and execute scripts/bench_regression.py extract + update-baseline.
